decision.explanation: The provided documents contain two conflicting assertions regarding the formation year of the 24th Rifle Division. Document 1 (D1S3) states the division was formed on July 26, 1918. Document 2 (D2S3) states the division was formed on January 1, 1920. Both documents describe the same entity ('24th Rifle Division' or '1st Simbirsk Infantry Division') and the same event ('formed on the order of the Revolutionary Military Council'). Per the instruction to preserve separately valid referents and complementary answers when competing assertions exist without a definitive resolution in the source text, both years are retained as valid answers derived from the original sources.
